value.title: ACE lifting, pulling and deploying - Ashtead Technology
value.main_text_excerpt:
ACE lifting, pulling and deploying
We are global leaders in the hire of lifting, pulling and deploying solutions
From concept design to full project delivery we offer bespoke and tailor-made equipment packages across the energy and civils sector, supporting a wide range of applications including; shore pulls, topside and jacket installation, pipe pulls, subsea tiebacks, riser installations and cable lay.
Our extensive rental fleet, unrivalled technical expertise and vast project track record allows us to work collaboratively with our customers to deliver innovative and reliable designs for the most complex of projects.
Explore what we do
Rental equipment
We offer an extensive range of back deck equipment for lifting, pulling and deployment applications, to support our customers’ global operations worldwide
Established in 1992, ACE Winches has a proven track record in
supporting the installation, inspection, maintenance and repair,
and decommissioning of offshore energy infrastructure.
Acquired by Ashtead Technology in December 2023, ACE Winches
complements and bolsters its mechanical solutions division.
Case studies
Showcasing the depth and breadth of our capability and expertise in the mechanical solutions field.
